editionTitle: World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King
mapName: Terrace of the Makers, The Storm Peaks

calibration.originDescription: Nominal full WoW 64x64 ADT grid frame (31,221.333 m per side). This shared coordinate frame is not the measured scene extent or playable-zone size. Boundary, subregion positions, generic feature anchors, and physical footprints in this pilot are low-confidence estimates.

sources.description: Noclip World of Warcraft scene catalog; the catalog label identifies the reference scene (Terrace of the Makers, The Storm Peaks) only. No game geometry, textures, or assets were extracted.
The Storm Peaks article used for zone naming and broad environmental context. This concept study does not claim that its polygons or measurements were traced from the article.
Used only to document the nominal 64x64 map-grid frame; not treated as playable-zone dimensions.

summary: Low-confidence concept study for testing map-driven generation across varied zones. The irregular boundary, one zone-wide baseline and five terrain-region polygons, generic feature footprints, and spacing values are estimates, not surveyed measurements or observations extracted from Noclip. Replace them with source-supported observations before treating this as a reference map.
